exclusion_reason: Cross-title CDN asset dedup is implemented: chunks publish into a content-addressed shared store, a payload shared across titles is written once and every later title hits the cache, and a differing hash is a distinct key that is never merged (a hit is validated against the stored bytes). The benchmark stays red because confirming the cross-title cache hit on a live CDN edge needs the absent hosting environment.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the shared payload is stored once, the second title hits the cache, and the differing-hash case never merges.
active_gate_evidence: test/package.test.mjs publishes two titles sharing a payload and asserts one stored copy plus a cache hit for the second, and that a differing payload becomes a separate store object.
procedure: Publish two title sharing a redistributable payload.
Assert one stored copy and a cache hit for the second.
Attempt to merge a differing hash and assert refusal.
